scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit --project cli --project db-sqlite
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && pnpm --dir extensions/vscode exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:db: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-postgres --project db-mysql --project db-sqlite --project db-oracle --project db-mssql
scripts.test:db:postgres: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-postgres
scripts.test:db:mysql: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-mysql
scripts.test:db:oracle: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-oracle
scripts.test:db:mssql: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-mssql
scripts.test:db:sqlite: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-sqlite
scripts.test:consumer: pnpm run build && vitest run --project consumer && pnpm run pack:check
scripts.test:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && vitest run && pnpm run test:vscode && pnpm run pack:check
scripts.test:lsp: pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit tests/lsp-protocol.test.ts
scripts.test:agent-tooling: pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit --project cli tests/tooling.test.ts tests/tooling-workspace.test.ts tests/language-server.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts
